correctness.rationale: The Euclidean orthotope displacement density is (1/V) prod_i (1-|z_i|/a_i)_+. Integrating expanded factors over a radius-r ball for 0<=r<=min a_i gives the exact Gamma-normalized polynomial. c0 fixes V; c1..c_{d-1} fix elementary reciprocal-length symmetric functions and e_d=1/V, so recover all side lengths. Perturb e_{d-1} with simple positive roots while fixing earlier coefficients proves sharp generic d-coefficient prefix. For r=a+h, disjoint coordinate caps and beta integral show the first correction coefficient t*8*kappa_{d-1}*(2a)^((d-1)/2)/(V*a*(d+1)*(d+3)), exponent (d+3)/2; all d>=3. Independent verification: Independently derived the ball monomial integration constants and d=3 cap coefficient for orthotope (1,2,3): pi/9 h^3. Inspected verify.py including its slicing quadrature, coefficient inversion and near-threshold comparisons, without relying on its advertised exit status. Analytic integration supplies the universal result.
